svg.aria-label: Quest log. Day quests: strata: make the agent pane feel like part of the terminal, not a guest in it; juno-assistant: get false wakes down without raising the miss rate; tessera: the TypeScript client, then Postgres instead of in-memory storage. Night quests: Watchnight: the next playable build, and more ways to lie convincingly; gamesmith: keep working through the curriculum; draw something every night. Side quests: rackwm: a real keybinding table, so the chords stop being hardcoded; Reading: distributed systems verification; Sleep: get a full eight hours (abandoned).
